The Xenosaga Freaks Reservation Privilege CD is the official soundtrack set for Xenosaga Freaks and the first release of the music of this game (the other ones being Kotoba no Puzzle Mojipittan Daijiten Original Soundtrack and Kotoba no Puzzle Mojipittan Original Soundtrack). It was composed by Satoru Kosaki and Hiroshi Okubo. While Freaks has a total of 24 songs, this soundtrack only contains 5 songs. It was released as a bonus for the preorder of Xenosaga Freaks in 2004. The first four songs in the album are songs that play in the Xeno-pittan minigame and are sung by the voice actresses of the three female main characters: Shion, KOS-MOS and MOMO. Yasuyuki Honne is a Japanese video game artist, director and producer. His main contributions to the Xeno- series are designing the conceptual artwork and map designs for various games, as well as being one of the founders of Monolith Soft.

It includes features such as enhanced graphics, additional voice acting, and additional gameplay features. The Nintendo Switch 2 Edition is available both as a standalone purchase and as a paid upgrade to the original version of Xenoblade Chronicles: Definitive Edition for the Nintendo Switch.

Xenogears is a hypothetical six-part game series, of which only one game actually materialized. That game, Xenogears, is actually the fifth episode in the series. The events of each episode, with the exception of the last one, is known thanks to the game's art- and lorebook, Xenogears Perfect Works.

Xenosaga Episode II - Jenseits von Gut und Böse () is a role-playing video game developed by Monolith Soft for the Sony PlayStation 2. It was published in Japan and North America by Namco and in Europe by Sony Computer Entertainment Europe.

Xenosaga Episode III - Also Sprach Zarathustra () is a role-playing video game developed by Monolith Soft and published by Namco Bandai. It was released in 2006 for the Sony PlayStation 2 in Japan and North America.

The Xeno series is the unofficial term used for Monolith Soft's group of games that begin with the prefix Xeno-, which include Xenogears, the Xenosaga series, and the Xenoblade Chronicles series collectively. Although the Xeno series of games share various common elements, they are not necessarily related to each other. Whilst all the games are developed by Monolith Soft (except for Xenogears), the three different Xeno titles are owned and published by three different companies, which are Square Enix, Bandai Namco Entertainment, and Nintendo respectively.

The Xenosaga Original Soundtrack is the official Soundtrack to Xenosaga Episode I - Der Wille zur Macht. It was released on 2 CDs only in Japan in 2002. All songs were composed by Yasunori Mitsuda. It was rereleased on the 19th of May, 2004 as Xenosaga Episode I with two additional tracks, World to be Born and Pain -piano version- , and a different order. Several tracks were rerecorded for the 2004 release. The CD release of the album was announced to be out of print on the 7th of February, 2024.

The Xenogears Original Soundtrack is the official soundtrack to Xenogears. It was originally released on 2 CDs in March 01, 1998, exclusively published in Japan. It consists of 44 pieces of music. 41 of these are instrumental; it also includes a choral song in the Bulgarian folk style performed by THE GREAT VOICES OF BULGARIA with lyrics written by Tetsuya Takahashi, and two other lyrical pieces performed by Joanne Hogg with lyrics written by Masato Kato. All tracks were composed and arranged by Yasunori Mitsuda. According to Mitsuda, the music was composed with strong influences from traditional music, especially Celtic music. The soundtrack was re-released on April 04, 2018 as Xenogears Or

The Xenosaga II: Jenseits Von Gut und Böse Movie Scene Soundtrack is the official soundtrack to Xenosaga Episode II - Jenseits von Gut und Böse. It was originally released on 2 CDs in 2004 under Victor Entertainment. A bootleg version was later released by Miya Records. Another soundtrack album, Xenosaga Episode II: Jenseits von Gut und Böse Soundtrack, was released in 2005; this version was much more limited, containing only 11 tracks on a single disc. While some tracks for the game (primarily cutscene themes) were composed by Yuki Kajiura and others (primarily battle and area themes) by Shinji Hosoe and Ayako Saso, only Kajiura's tracks were released on either album.

The Xenogears 20th Anniversary Concert -The Beginning and the End- was a concert held in April 2018, featuring orchestral arrangements of the Xenogears Original Soundtrack, as well as performances of certain tracks from the Xenogears Original Soundtrack Revival Disc -the first and the last- and CREID. Arrangements were done by Yasunori Mitsuda, Sachiko Miyano, Mariam Abounnasr, and Youki Yamamoto, with vocals by ANÚNA and Joanne Hogg. A Blu-ray disc recording of the concert was released in 2019.

The Xenoblade Chronicles: Definitive Edition Sound Selection ( SOUND SELECTION, Xenoblade Definitive Edition Sound Selection) is a selection of 20 tracks from the soundtrack of Xenoblade Chronicles: Definitive Edition (all of which had been remastered or composed for this game), released on the 29th of May, 2020 as part of the Collector's Edition of the game in Europe, Japan and Australia. It was released on a single CD in Japan and Australia, and as a download card in Europe. The European version of the Collector's Edition also included a vinyl version with 12 tracks.

The Xenosaga Episode II: Jenseits von Gut und Böse Soundtrack is a collection of tracks from the music of Xenosaga Episode II, released on the 17th of February, 2005, included with the Strategy Guide published by Brady Games. It consists of 11 tracks (all composed by Yuki Kajiura) on a single disc. All of the tracks on the disc were also included in the Xenosaga II: Jenseits Von Gut und Böse Movie Scene Soundtrack.
Xenogears Perfect Works ~The Real Thing~, typically referred to as just Perfect Works is a book about Xenogears. It was published by Digicube in August 1998.
Xeno Card is a minigame in Xenosaga Episode I - Der Wille zur Macht. It is a virtual trading card game.
Yacud Cannon is an enemy in Xenosaga Episode II - Jenseits von Gut und Böse.

Wraith Feeler is a boss in Xenosaga Episode II - Jenseits von Gut und Böse. They are fought as part of GS 13, accompanying the boss Wraith Virus. The Wraith Virus can call more when the feelers are defeated. Even if the Wraith Virus is down, the feelers need to be defeated to complete the fight.
Yacud Cannon Revised is an enemy in Xenosaga Episode III - Also Sprach Zarathustra.

Xenosaga II to III: A Missing Year ~Fragments of Truth Sealed in the U.M.N.~ (), also known simply as Xenosaga: A Missing Year, is a Flash video series that was released on 's Japanese promotional website with the first chapter released on May 9th 2006 and the last chapter released on July 5th, 2006. It was taken down some time after the release of Xenosaga Episode III; a novelized version was later made available in the Episode III Official Complete Guide that depicts the story in chronological order and from Jin's perspective. Neither version was officially released outside of Japan. The primary focus of the story is detailing the events that take place between Xenosaga II and Xenosaga Epi

The Xenosaga Forum was the official English-language forum for the Xenosaga series. It launched in 2003 and went read-only on , 6:00PM EST. The servers closed in early 2005. At the same time, the Xenosaga®2 Forum, a subforum of the general Namco forums, opened. The last time the original forum was archived on the Internet Archive was on , the North American release date of Xenosaga Episode II. A week later, it was inaccessible.

Xenosaga Outer File () is a series of drama CDs that details some events that take place before and during Xenosaga Episode I - Der Wille zur Macht. It was released in 3 CDs in between late 2002 and early 2003 exclusively in Japan. One of the primary focuses of the story is an extended backstory for Captain Matthews and the rest of the Elsa's crew, as well as their conflict with the antagonists Richard and Hermann, who make their first series appearance in Outer File.

Xenoblade 2 Official Artworks Alrest Record () is an art book published by Gzbrain, initially planned to release on February 2nd, 2019, but officially released on February 12th, 2019 after being pushed back to answer to unexpectedly high preorder numbers. The release date printed on the books stayed February 2nd. It was later reissued by KADOKAWA. It contains 352 pages of various artwork and materials for Xenoblade Chronicles 2 and Xenoblade Chronicles 2: Torna ~ The Golden Country.

Xenoblade X The Secret File Art of MIRA () is an art book published by KADOKAWA that was released on December 25, 2015. This art book contains 320 pages of various artwork and materials for Xenoblade Chronicles X, including the short story Skells Reborn, which takes place during the events of the game.

Xenoblade: The Secret File - MONADO Archives () is an art book published by ASCII Media Works released on November 19th, 2010 in Japan, with a version releasing in France on August 19th, 2011. It contains various artwork and materials for Xenoblade Chronicles, alongside interviews with Monolith Soft’s staff.

is a track in Xenosaga Episode II. It has not been released on any soundtrack or sound selection and not much is known about this track. It plays in the following cutscenes: * Jr. mentally tries to ask Gaignun to get Helmer to send them backup on Second Miltia. * Jr. returns to the bridge of the Durandal after the events of the Ormus Stronghold (Japanese audio only — in the English version of the game, no music plays in this cutscene).

is a track in Xenosaga Episode II. It has not been released on any soundtrack or sound selection and not much is known about this track. It plays in the following cutscenes: * Albedo complains about the non-Variant U.R.T.V.s while Yuriev prepares the dive into Sakura's subconscious domain during the summer (Japanese audio only — in the English version of the game, no music plays in this cutscene). * Yuriev is briefed on the situation with Old Miltia after his reawakening. * Yuriev reveals to Pellegri that he is alive. * Yuriev begins his first conversation with the party.

is a track in Xenosaga Episode II. It has not been released on any soundtrack or sound selection and not much is known about this track. It plays in the cutscene when Jr. tells Yuriev that he will stop Albedo but not kill him.
